interpretation: Most reviewed sources describe pathways, policy designs, market structures, safeguards or governance mechanisms
decision_rule: Do not promote mechanism to operation without a named implementation and decision record
next_acquisition: retrieve implementation, exposure and response for a named actor/place

interpretation: Global scale, trend, stock, strategy, scenario, definition or process signals are common
decision_rule: Do not treat scale or scenario as person, household, community or project outcome
next_acquisition: join signal to a dated unit-level event and later consequence

interpretation: Some sources describe a simulation, regulatory pathway, conditional adoption or technical operation
decision_rule: Do not treat a technical or administrative operation as adequate benefit, safety or remedy
next_acquisition: follow operation through user encounter, distribution and recurrence

interpretation: The source direction is credible but the precise stage or claim scope is only partly established
decision_rule: retain uncertainty and do not upgrade without exact population, method and outcome
next_acquisition: read full method and add page/section-level support

interpretation: The remaining claims have a bounded signal, mechanism, operation, pathway, counterexample or normative status
decision_rule: preserve the exact status label and missing boundary
next_acquisition: acquire the unobserved next stage rather than add more upstream commentary

interpretation: Browser or alternate official routes were needed for some high-authority sources
decision_rule: Record route type separately from substantive support
next_acquisition: capture stable document identity, date and method

interpretation: Normal or retry requests reached the endpoint
decision_rule: Reachability is necessary but not sufficient

interpretation: No reviewed claim closes the entire named-unit chain from exposure through adequate, durable and contestable outcome
decision_rule: Keep Tier 1 distinctions and Tier 2 conversions separate
next_acquisition: join one person, household, worker, community, facility or place to outcome and counterexample
